title: Handshake lemma for multigraphs
statement:
Let $G$ be a loopless multigraph, given by a finite vertex set $V$ together with a multiset $E$ of edges, each edge an unordered pair of distinct vertices of $V$. For a vertex $v$, let $\deg(v)$ be the number of edges of $G$ incident to $v$, counted with multiplicity. Then
\[
  \sum_{v \in V} \deg(v) = 2\,\abs{E},
\]
where $\abs{E}$ is the number of edges counted with multiplicity.
hypotheses_covered: G is a multigraph with a finite vertex set
edges form a multiset (counted with multiplicity)
edges are loopless / endpoints are distinct vertices
deg(v) counts incident edges with multiplicity
